plants.name: Tulipa gesneriana
plants.description: A spring-flowering bulb with cup-shaped blooms on sturdy stems above broad blue-green leaves. Late-season varieties such as Darwin hybrids and parrot tulips are at their peak in early May in cool temperate gardens.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid to late spring (April to May in the Northern Hemisphere)
plants.location: Netherlands, northern Europe, the northern United States, Canada, and cultivated worldwide in temperate gardens
plants.funFact: During the Dutch Golden Age in the 1630s, tulip bulbs became so valuable that a single rare bulb could cost more than a house, a episode known as Tulip Mania.

plants.name: Syringa vulgaris
plants.description: A deciduous shrub producing dense, cone-shaped clusters of intensely fragrant tiny flowers. It reaches peak bloom in early to mid May across much of the cool temperate Northern Hemisphere.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late spring (May in most temperate regions)
plants.location: Native to the Balkan Peninsula; widely grown in North America, Europe, and northern Asia
plants.funFact: Lilac flowers are edible and have a floral, slightly bitter flavor; they are sometimes used to make syrups, jellies, and sugar.

plants.name: Wisteria sinensis
plants.description: A vigorous woody climbing vine that drapes pergolas and walls with long hanging racemes of fragrant pea-like flowers. Blooms open before or as the leaves emerge, creating cascades of color.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid to late spring (April to May)
plants.location: Native to China; naturalized and cultivated in Japan, Europe, and the eastern United States
plants.funFact: Wisteria vines can live for over a century, and the famous Great Wisteria in Sierra Madre, California, planted in 1894, covers more than an acre.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Not in bloom everywhere yet, but in the Southern Hemisphere and tropics this is a spectacular tree with fern-like leaves and trumpet-shaped flowers in dense panicles. In tropical regions of the northern hemisphere such as parts of India and Florida, it flowers in May.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late spring to early summer in the Northern Hemisphere subtropics (May to June); spring in the Southern Hemisphere (October to November)
plants.location: Native to South America; planted in India, Florida, Southern California, Mexico, and Africa
plants.funFact: In South Africa, Pretoria is known as the Jacaranda City because of the tens of thousands of trees lining its streets.
